create_InputLayer: create an InputLayer module that converts coordinate and feature tensors into a SparseConvNetTensor with configurable duplicate handling mode
create_OutputLayer: create an OutputLayer module that converts a SparseConvNetTensor back into a float feature tensor for autoencoder-style networks
create_BLInputLayer: create a BLInputLayer module that processes batched 3D coordinate and feature tensors into a SparseConvNetTensor
create_BLOutputLayer: create a BLOutputLayer module that converts a SparseConvNetTensor back into batched 3D feature tensors
create_InputLayerInput: create an InputLayerInput wrapper object that holds coords and features with indexing and cuda conversion support
